commander.satan: The quartermaster asked Pavel "Tin" Satan to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The First Wave ribbon marked Pavel "Tin" Satan as an early volunteer. At R-F13, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
knightowlvt: Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt stepped off the supply cart at R-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Emil "Shadow" Knightowlvt was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
